exposure: operative intervention in second stage of labor
expectant management of prolonged second stage of labor
outcome: Chest compressions or intubation at birth
Transfer to a long-term care facility
cohort: 218 women with live singleton pregnancies at ≥36 weeks who reached the second stage of labor
finding: Expectant management of a prolonged second stage of labor was associated with a higher rate of adverse maternal outcomes, but not neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study assessed the impact of a prolonged second stage of labor on maternal and neonatal outcomes by comparing women who had expectant management versus operative intervention.
